profile.name: THE THAI SETAKIJ INSURANCE PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: The Company primarily provides non-life insurance underwriting services, covering key insurance products including fire insurance, marine cargo insurance, motor insurance, and miscellaneous insurance. In addition, the Company manages investments in various securities and financial instruments to strengthen its financial stability and support overall business performance.
